name: How long does professional soot removal take?

mainEntity.name: How long does professional soot removal take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of professional soot removal depends on the severity and scope of the damage. A small area with light soot might only take a few hours to a day. For more extensive soot, such as after a significant puff-back or a fire, the process could take several days to a week or more, especially if it involves contents cleaning, deodorization, and structural repairs. Your restoration professional will provide a more accurate timeline after assessing the specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Soot removal time varies from hours for light damage to days or weeks for extensive cases, depending on severity, scope, and additional services like deodorization.
